_readme: HV Capital's own portfolio export, https://www.hvcapital.com/api/portfolio-csv?lang=en (the 'export' button on hvcapital.com/portfolio, PortfolioExportButton in the site's JS), downloaded 2026-09-29 as sources/site/portfolio-2026.csv (154 rows) and reshaped here one row per company. Fields as the firm publishes them: Founded, Founders, HV Entry (year; -> invest_year), HQ, Funding (the HV fund(s) that hold the position), Stage (the company's CURRENT stage: early/growth/acquired/ipo; never an entry label), Stage at Entry (early/growth: the firm's claim about the stage at which IT entered), Status (Active/Past), Categories, Website. url is the per-company case page where one renders (22 rows), else the portfolio page.
